verdict.rationale: LocalAI is primarily an inference runtime and platform, not just an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Every MCP mention in the evidence is client-side: LocalAI connects models and agents to external MCP servers. No evidence shows LocalAI itself running as an MCP server that other agents can connect to, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
